title: T-02 - The Trinity Unified
claim: The Trinity is presented as the theological ground of existence, distinction, relation, and orientation, with selected triadic structures in physics treated as graded bridge correspondences rather than proofs.
assumptions: Christian Trinitarian theology is allowed to speak in its own register.
Physics-side correspondences do not become theological proof without an explicitly declared bridge.
The source document remains a working internal canon draft, not a public final paper.
definitions: Opening postulates: existence, distinction, relation, orientation.
Bridge correspondence: a cross-register structural resonance that is named with limits.
negative_guards: Do not say physics proves the Trinity.
Do not reduce the Trinity to a quantum or mathematical metaphor.
Do not present all five convergence instances as equally proven.
kill_conditions: If the physics examples are presented as formal proof rather than graded correspondence, the bridge claim fails.
If the claimed Lean theorem names or theorem count cannot be verified, those proof labels must be downgraded.
If the Big Bang/prior-observer argument is stated as standard physics, the section must be quarantined or rewritten.

ledger.meaning: Source claim ingested into Lane 4 ledger.

ledger.limits: HTML condensation requires a cooling pass before canon-lock; presentation does not upgrade physics, bridge, or Lean claims beyond their verified registers.
